ideas.prompt: Using Friedemann Sallis, Valentina Bertolani, Jan Burle and Laura Zattra (editors) — Live-Electronic Music: Composition, Performance, Study, especially Jan Burle on Fixing the fugitive, build a Neon Orbit listening drill around MicroFreak as unstable co-performer: separate what is fixed from what is live, then make the live part necessary rather than decorative.
